paper_title: Searching for solar axions using data from the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory
notes: Paper constrains the isovector axion-nucleon coupling |g3_aN| = |gan-gap|/2 > 2e-5 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for sub-MeV axion masses (exclusion band between 2e-5 and 1e-3 GeV^-1 up to ~5.5 MeV). Note this coupling is in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling), unlike the dimensionless g_an convention in the rubric. Under the assumption of no cancellation between gan and gap, the limit applies to gan/gap individually; hence AxionNeutron is the closest enum match but the primary quantity is isovector g3_aN. Confidence reduced because the primary observable is g3_aN (isovector) rather than g_an specifically, and units differ from the dimensionless convention.
